sources.title: STAMP · Directions & Parking
sources.supports: Campus Drive rises from the eastern campus toward STAMP; the student union fronts the Campus Drive / Union Lane intersection. Union Lane Garage serves this entrance.

sources.title: Feller Center · Directions to Union Lane Garage
sources.supports: Turn from Campus Drive onto Union Lane, then left onto Fieldhouse Drive; the garage vehicle entrance is on Fieldhouse Drive. The walking exit rises toward STAMP.

sources.title: STAMP · Accessibility Resources
sources.supports: Union Lane Garage lies west of STAMP; curb cuts connect the sidewalks and accessible building entrances.

sources.title: Maryland iMAP · UMD Roads
sources.supports: Existing campus pavement polygons, preserved and draped onto the shared campus terrain.

implementation.scope: Campus Drive hill at STAMP, Union Lane and the Fieldhouse Drive parking garage connection; layered road, verge, sidewalk, curb cuts, crossings, tree pockets and restrained street furniture.
implementation.limitations: Centre lines and furniture positions are authored to the existing compressed game coordinate frame. This is an exterior reconstruction, not surveyed as-built roadway geometry or a depiction of the 2026 Purple Line construction closures. Street widths, planting and material treatments are authored.
